name: games-analytics
description: Analyze Steam, Google Play, and App Store reviews with resumable harness or BYOK batch workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Turn cross-platform game reviews into product insights.
interface.longDescription: Mine public Steam, Google Play, and App Store reviews, classify them through your current agent or an OpenRouter batch job, compare games, and generate detailed HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Analyze what players dislike about this game.
Compare complaints across Steam and mobile games.
Find underserved game ideas from public reviews.
